detail.title: CS110 CPU Tower Stand - Choco Walnut
detail.overview: The Ant Esports CS110 is a rolling CPU tower stand built to keep a PC case off the floor, improving airflow and cutting down on dust buildup around the tower. Its 18mm thick wooden top board holds up to 70kg, giving it enough strength for even heavier full-tower builds, while four caster wheels with a bayonet locking mechanism let it move freely or lock firmly in place once positioned. The wheels rotate a full 360 degrees for easy repositioning under or beside a desk, making it simple to access the case for cleaning or upgrades. Finished in a rich Choco Walnut tone, it adds a sleek, muted look to any home office or gaming setup while keeping the PC organised and protected.
